references.text: Isaiah prophesies about the miracles the Messiah will perform, including healing the blind, lame, lepers, and deaf, as well as raising the dead and preaching to the poor.
Isaiah predicts that the coming Messiah will preach good news to the poor, which is fulfilled in Jesus' ministry.

Jesus refers to His works, including healing the blind, lame, lepers, and deaf, raising the dead, and preaching to the poor as proof that He is the One who was to come, in accordance with the prophecies.
